subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@kitebank.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@kitebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciate the candid conversation and the context on the conversational banking use cases you shared. Quick recap of what we covered and a proposed POC approach so your team can evaluate Redwood end-to-end.

Demo recap:
- Showed end-to-end agent flow (ingest -> retrieval -> generation) with rate/latency expectations for your 200 reqs/min baseline.
- Highlighted model routing (latency vs cost), prefix caching, and logging/audit features in the Console.
- Walked through embedding pipeline and document search for account docs + transaction metadata.

Proposed POC (goal: confirm production viability for customer support & KYC assist workflows)
1) Success criteria (what KiteBank needs to see):
   - Accuracy: >= 85% on a 200-sample QA prompt set (precision on account lookups + policy responses).
   - Latency: 95th percentile <= 450ms for short responses under the reserved capacity profile.
   - Security: logs + audit trail visible in Console; data residency confirmed (US region).
   - Cost: baseline per-token forecast and 30% improvement from suggested batching/quantization config.
2) Evaluation plan:
   - Redwood provides a dedicated sandbox with model + infra config for 2 weeks.
   - KiteBank supplies a 200-item prompt set and 3 sample document collections (anonymized).
   - Run daily smoke tests; at the end of week 1 we’ll collect metrics, week 2 we’ll iterate on prompts and model settings.
3) Timeline:
   - Kickoff: target Mon, 3 May 2027
   - Sandbox live: 3 May - 17 May (2 full weeks)
   - Final review: 18 May 2027
4) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (sales, POC owner), Dylan Brooks (solutions eng, tech lead)
   - KiteBank: Samir Patel (product owner), Priya Rao (security/compliance)
5) Next steps/action items:
   - I’ve attached a short POC plan + checklist (redwood-poc-plan-kitebank-v1.pdf, redwood-poc-checklist-kitebank.xlsx).
   - Can you confirm the 3 May kickoff and share the anonymized prompt set + sample docs by EOD Thu, 29 Apr?
   - If you want a written SOW or an NDA, let me know - we can loop Legal quickly.

Thanks - I’ll have Dylan reach out with a quick technical checklist and network requirements after you confirm the kickoff date.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-kitebank-v1.pdf, redwood-poc-checklist-kitebank.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@kitebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@kitebank.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap and the materials. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the accuracy goal looks reasonable. Can we define the QA prompt set scoring rubric (exact match vs. semantic match)? We’ll want to agree before the tests.
2) Data access: on the sample docs - we can provide anonymized exports but need to confirm the sandbox access will be private to KiteBank and logs are retained per our retention policy.
3) Support: will a Redwood SE be on call during initial tests for prompt tuning?

Also, Priya will review the security checklist and come back with any gaps. Assuming those items are OK, 3 May kickoff works.

On Sun, 25 Apr 2027 at 3:10 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir / Priya,
> 
> Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciate the candid conversation and the context on the conversational banking use cases you shared. Quick recap of what we covered and a proposed POC approach so your team can evaluate Redwood end-to-end.

Thanks,
Samir
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@kitebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@kitebank.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank

Samir - perfect, thanks for the quick read. Replies inline and next steps below.

1) Scoring rubric: we’ll provide a simple scoring template (attached as a tab in the checklist) that includes exact-match, token-overlap, and a human-judged semantic-bucket. Dylan will own the initial scoring run and we’ll iterate on thresholds together.
2) Sandbox privacy & logs: the sandbox will be provisioned in a KiteBank-dedicated namespace in our US region. Logs and audit trails will be visible to KiteBank in the Console; retention can be configured (we’ll document default retention and options). Priya — I’ll send the security checklist summary separately so you have the items to review.
3) SE support: yes - Dylan will be on-call for the first 3 days of the sandbox and available during weekly check-ins to assist with prompt engineering and config changes.

Proposed kickoff details:
- Kickoff meeting: Mon, 3 May 2027 at 10:00am PT (30–45m) - agenda: environment access, prompt set handoff, initial smoke test, roles.
- Pre-kickoff deliverables (due Thu, 29 Apr): anonymized prompt set + sample docs, network allowlist if needed.

Action items assigned:
- Samir: confirm kickoff time and share prompt set by 29 Apr.
- Priya: confirm any required data residency/retention constraints and review the security checklist.
- Dylan (cc): I’ve asked him to prepare the quick network/access checklist and a scoring template.
- Marissa: provide final POC plan and SOW if needed.

I’ve attached the scoring template in the checklist and updated the POC plan with the timeline. If that all sounds good I’ll send a calendar invite for 3 May and get Dylan to start the pre-kickoff checklist.

Best,
Marissa
